reason: I forget my vitamins on the counter all the time, so a sachet I just grab and take in the evening is actually the first thing that fits how I live. At $24.99 for the first box I would try one, because the empty-box guarantee means I am not stuck if it does nothing.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli and those last longer. I only pay more if the sachet thing really gets me to take it every day.
would_change_my_mind: A creator video showing the sachet in a real evening routine, or the price staying at $24.99 after launch.
